headline: DeepSeek's new flash model hits 8.7% in debut
summary: DeepSeek's freshly minted deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 just set an all-time token-share record at 8.7%, vaulting straight to rank 5 with a 5.1% single-day jump. The provider's overall dominance continues to swell—DeepSeek now commands 25.8% of the market, up 5.6 points in a day. Meanwhile, OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna took a 3.9% hit and dropped to rank 2, while Tencent's hy4-preview stumbled 2.9 points in 24 hours.
highlights: deepseek-v4.1-flash-20260910 debuts at rank 5 with 8.7% share—a new all-time record
DeepSeek's daily provider share surges +5.6% to 25.8%, now holding nearly a quarter of all tokens
OpenAI slips to rank 2 after losing 3.9% share; gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 drops from rank 1
Four new models entered the top 50: Anthropic's claude-4.7-opus, Qwen's qwen3.8-flash, and two InclusionAI variants
Qwen's qwen3.8-max and thinkingmachines' inkling both fell out of the rankings
